messages:
liam: FYI inbound SIG/CAIQ from Solar Analytics. They want us to complete the questionnaire + provide SOC2 report, pen-test summary, KMS details. POC request: 2-week eval using their telemetry (no PII). Can security take intake?

marta: Taking this. Please drop the questionnaire here and the customer's contact. I’ll triage for red/amber/green and flag blockers.

liam: Link to questionnaire: https://drive.google.com/placeholder (uploaded). Contact: kate@solar-analytics.io. They also want an NDA before sharing production-ish samples. @anna-legal can you send NDA? They require EU data residency for POC.

security-bot: Created ticket SD-78921 in Security Intake queue (assignee: unassigned).

marta: Noted. Preliminary asks to confirm: 1) exact data types (telemetry only?), 2) will they provide a sanitized sample dataset for the POC?, 3) what's the SSO/identity plan (SAML preferred?), 4) any long-term retention needs. Also will need encryption-at-rest/KMS details for the docs.

liam: Confirmed telemetry only (device + usage metrics, no customer PII). They said they will share a sanitized sample. SSO via SAML preferred but can use API keys for initial POC. Retention: standard 30 days for POC.

oliver: For the POC infra: we can spin a Dedicated dev pool in eu-west-1 and pin model to a stable build. Need an estimate of qps / daily requests to size the pool.

liam: Estimate ~5k requests/day during the 2-week POC, peak ~15 qps.

marta: OK. For the SIG/CAIQ I’ll fill high-level answers and request SOC2/pen-test artifacts if required. Initial triage ETA 3 business days. If we need infra diagrams I’ll ping eng-infra for topology and KMS integration details.

anna-legal: NDA template sent to kate@solar-analytics.io and cc liam. Please confirm when executed.

security-bot: SD-78921 updated: assignee -> marta. SLA: initial triage due in 3 business days.

marta: Assigning follow-ups: I’ll own the questionnaire + risk tag. @oliver — can you drop the POC infra snippet we’ll use (region, pool size, model pin)? Example config below: 
```yaml
service: redwood-poc
mode: dedicated
region: eu-west-1
gpu_pool: small
model: redwood-v2.1-quant
```

oliver: Will post exact config and memory/cpu targets by EOD.

liam: Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Kate and push their sample dataset to the secure S3 shared bucket once NDA is signed. Will add manifest of columns.

marta: Closing loop for now — SD-78921 assigned to me. I’ll update this thread with the SIG/CAIQ draft and any blockers (SOC2 doc, pen-test summary, or infra diagram). Tagging sales when we have green/amber/red. :thumbsup:
